serverInfo.name: sensitive-check
serverInfo.title: SocialDataX 敏感检测 MCP
serverInfo.description: SocialDataX 敏感词/违禁词/文案合规, sensitive word/content risk checks for generic/XHS/Douyin/Kuaishou.

instructions: This MCP server does not provide account login, posting, editing, liking, writing comments or replies, or other account actions. Configure your API Key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header and use `tools/list` or `resources/list` for discovery.

tools.name: check_sensitive_text

text.description: 需要检查敏感词、违禁词或平台审核风险的原文文本。

platform.description: 目标平台规则。generic 表示通用敏感检测；xhs、douyin、kuaishou 分别表示按对应平台常见内容审核风险做检测。

tools.description: 敏感检测、敏感词检测、违禁词检查与文案合规检查：检查一段社媒文案是否存在潜在平台审核风险。

tools.name: socialdatax_get_points_balance
tools.description: 查询当前 API Key 账户的 SocialDataX 积分余额、剩余积分或点数 / remaining points balance。需要充值时请访问 https://socialdatax.com/dashboard/billing。

resources.name: server_card
resources.title: MCP Server Card
resources.description: Static discovery metadata for directory publishing and manual inspection.
